audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 against a 54.78% win rate over 2205 games, with the chart giving Akshan all seven rows, is defensible: Lux has no mobility and no disengage, so once Akshan closes the range gap the lane is his at every stage. The only chart defect was structural — phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while win[N] read 'Akshan'.
audit.corrected: phases[N].side realigned to win[N] as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] is built on a mechanic Akshan does not have — 'your dash-refund off Q hits' — and on 'the long W-cast animation', which Prismatic Barrier does not have.
audit.why: Akshan has no dash and no cooldown refund off Avengerang; Heroic Swing is a grappling hook that requires terrain and can be knocked off by champion or wall collision. Prismatic Barrier is a thrown shield with no long cast. The real levels 3-5 spike is Light Binding's flat 10-second cooldown: that ability is her only lockdown, and the window after it is when Akshan closes the 325-unit range deficit.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rebuilt on the flat 10s Light Binding window and the range gap.
sources: brief ownerKit Q/E text (no dash, no refund)
brief enemyKit W text and Q cd 10

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (1) breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d claim you can 'minion-block' Light Binding so her combo never starts. (2) wants.foe[0] describes a 'Q-W combo' as her poke. (3) Nothing states that Lucent Singularity reveals stealth.
audit.why: Light Binding 'binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units' — it passes through the first target onto a second, so a single minion does not stop it. Prismatic Barrier (W) is a shield, not damage; her poke pattern is Lucent Singularity (E) at 1100 dropped as a zone, then Light Binding at 1175 into it. And Lucent Singularity reveals stealth, so Akshan's W camouflage does not hide him from a Lux who drops it on his position — this is the interaction that most changes how Akshan plays the lane and it appears nowhere on the page. Range picture overall: her Q 1175 / W 1150 / E 1100 / R 3340 against his Q 850, a 325-unit deficit the page never states.
audit.corrected: Two-unit bind, the E-into-Q poke order, the stealth reveal, and the 325-unit range gap all written in.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E/R text, ranges and flags (revealsStealth on E)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers and rested on the incorrect minion-block claim.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank — the most countable cooldown in the lane. Lucent Singularity is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Final Spark is 60/50/40.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illumination — her passive mark and the auto-attack that detonates it — was not mentioned.
audit.why: Her damaging spells charge the target, and her next basic attack ignites it for bonus damage scaling with her level. The wind-up on that auto is the tell that the trade is not over, which is exactly what the brief's autoreset-burst-tell flag points at.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[0].d as the reason not to stand in a loaded combo.

edits.before: Level 1-2: your melee trades and Q sustain edge out her cautious poke before she has mana to spam Q-W.
edits.after: Level 1-2: she outranges you 1175 to 850, but Light Binding is a flat 10s and she has no mana to spam.

edits.before: Level 3: Heroic Swing gives you a reliable gap-close onto a champion with zero disengage tools.
edits.after: Level 3: Heroic Swing needs a wall to work, but Lux has zero disengage once you arrive.

edits.before: Your dash-refund off Q hits gives you free trades into Lux's skillshots — dodge one Light Binding and you punish the long W-cast animation before she resets.
edits.after: Light Binding is a flat 10 seconds and it is her only lockdown — dodge it or put two minions in the line, and the ten seconds after are yours to close 325 units of range.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close because Lux's Light Binding threatens your dash windows, but her skillshots are dodgeable behind minions and you outtrade in melee range if she ever pushes to last-hit.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are close because Lux outranges you 1175 to 850 and Lucent Singularity zones the wave, but every one of her spells is a skillshot, and inside 850 your string wins the exchange outright.

edits.before: From level 3 onward you're fully ahead: Heroic Swing lets you close the gap she needs to keep, Avengerang punishes her positioning, and by 6 Comeuppance turns any dive she takes into a kill for you since she has no hard peel.
edits.after: From level 3 onward you are ahead, but Heroic Swing needs a wall — scout your angles before you need them. Lucent Singularity reveals stealth, so W camouflage will not hide you from it. By 6, Comeuppance punishes any step she takes past the wave.

edits.before: Hide behind minions to avoid free poke, then punish her CS animation
edits.after: Light Binding passes through one unit — stand behind two minions

edits.before: Land Q-W combo from max range to poke you down safely
edits.after: Drop Lucent Singularity at 1100, then bind you inside it

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Heroic Swing for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — a flat 10s at every rank, 1175 range, and it binds up to two units, so one minion does not block it. - Lucent Singularity is 10s and reveals stealth, so it finds your W. - Final Spark is 60s at rank 1.

edits.before: That is Lux’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Her spells charge you; the next auto detonates that mark.

edits.before: Lux wins by landing Light Binding, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Lux wins by binding you at 1175 and detonating Lucent Singularity into Final Spark before you close the 325.

notes: The worst thing on this page was a mechanic Akshan does not have: spikes[0] told the reader about 'your dash-refund off Q hits', and whys[1], mid and spikes[3] all describe Heroic Swing as a dash or a 'dash combo'. It is a grappling hook that requires terrain and that champion or wall collision knocks him off — advice built on a free gap-close will get people killed against a champion whose entire defence is spacing. Second real correction: the page twice told readers to minion-block Light Binding so 'her combo never starts', but Riot's text says it binds up to two enemy units, so one minion in the line does not save you. Third: Lucent Singularity reveals stealth and therefore answers Akshan's W camouflage — absent from the whole page and now in mid and breakdown.cooldowns. Left alone deliberately: whys[2] and whys[3] are near-identical templated sentences about 'all-in pressure' at levels 4-5, and breakdown.carry, breakdown.wave and ahead are all champion-swap templates. I could not ground replacements for them in anything specific to Lux beyond what I had already used, so I left them rather than invent. See sectionsMissing.
